verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS AI agent platform with a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The trust page's generic line about deploying AI 'within your own boundaries' is a related compliance claim, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
